metadata.title: Micro-SaaS Studio Builder — a demo for Dotworld
metadata.description: A Next.js back-office that launches an AI micro-SaaS in minutes and runs it on data: Test → Learn → Scale.

hero.eyebrow: A small demo — application to Dotworld
hero.title: A back-office to generate and run AI micro-SaaS products in minutes
hero.description: From the back-office, a new product is created by filling in a form, and each one is run on data — funnel, AI cost, margin — up to the decision: scale it, or cut it.
hero.demoNote: Public demo: payment and email are simulated here.
hero.buildNote: Built with Claude Code, specs and tests included:

portfolio.title: The portfolio
portfolio.description: Every product at a glance: visits, conversion, revenue, AI cost, margin, and the "scale it" or "cut it" suggestion.
portfolio.alt: Back-office portfolio: four studio-wide KPIs over 30 days and the product table with its status.

product.title: The product sheet
product.description: Each product's funnel, from visit to purchase, and its visits and purchases curve.
product.alt: LettrePro product sheet: revenue, ARPU, AI cost, margin per generation and conversion funnel.

productForm.title: Creating a product
productForm.description: A 7-step form, with a live preview of the landing page as you type.
productForm.alt: Product creation form, Landing & SEO step, with the landing preview on the right.

whyThisDemo.title: Why this project
whyThisDemo.description: Several SaaS products running in parallel, a modern stack, agentic development at the core of the process, self-funded and profitable from year one, grown from 1 to over 50 people in four years: a model that has proven itself. This demo is my way of concretely showing the wish to learn this model and contribute to it, by exploring its core business at my own scale.

productsShowcase.title: The studio's products
productsShowcase.description: Each one is a configuration of the same foundation, served on its own URL: click a card to try it live.
productsShowcase.createDescription: A form in the back-office is enough to launch a new one, in a few minutes.

howItsBuilt.title: How it's built
howItsBuilt.tagline: "We develop with AI, not alongside it": this repo shows the method as much as the product.

specs.title: Specs before code
specs.description: One spec per feature, written before the implementation: behaviour, edge cases, acceptance criteria.

tdd.title: TDD across the whole implementation
tdd.description: Every acceptance behaviour is tested before it's coded, red then green.

review.title: One spec, one multi-angle agentic review, one PR
review.description: Every feature goes through several specialized review agents — correctness, Next.js, database, security — before being merged.
